conditions.human_role: User supplied shelfmark, date, prior-art summary and suggested Devos 1950 keys.

solution.what: Local cached cryptiana GL.htm and unsolved.htm locate f.196 at Gallica view 280 and explicitly list its short ciphertext as undeciphered. No reading consulted.
Gallica highres, IIIF native/default, item and manifest endpoints return HTTP 403; live cryptiana returns 503. Alternate access investigation continues.
Downloaded Wikimedia Commons mirrors with descriptive User-Agent; f280 is folio 164, not target. Located target at views 336-340 (ff196-198).
Inspected five written pages: two encrypted passages at 196v/197r, Madrid 8 August 1596 and signature on 198r. Live cryptiana fetched over HTTP with User-Agent.
Draft 114-token transcription; found missing e D at clear/cipher boundary; tested splitting joined dc/lb/B into q-u/e-l/e-s and distinguishing final looped L.

Python homophonic annealing failed; constrained pronostico crib also failed and rejected. C# annealing, 250 restarts each on joined, dots-collapsed and split/dots-collapsed variants. Only split variant produced coherent spans: dizen que el mundo..., el rey, ...escudero, paresce que anda...

Using solver-derived spans and manuscript, recovered comet passage: dizen que el mundo se acabara o morira el rey por setiembre ...; first passage includes Aponte and Escudero. No external plaintext used. Remaining singletons and segmentation under examination.
Compared published Descovar, Fuentes-Pimentel, Ibarra-Doria, Ibarra-Zuniga and Cg.13 symbol sets; no direct match. Devos 1950 full tables not obtained; not claimed tested.
Final image-based key gives all eight cipher runs; two nulls, openC=t, Q=n, X=m and ud=ll remain M. Raw text and editorial caveats in reading.md.
Decoder roundtrip reproduces saved literal runs; measured 125 tokens, 35 types, I=119 M=6. No external key or independent decipherment verifies the solution.

outcome.method_basis: The key was rebuilt from the ciphertext alone by C# homophonic annealing over a Spanish order-5 model after image re-segmentation; no external plaintext or key was found or used.
outcome.fraction_read_source: token_reading.tsv generated by decode.py: 125 cipher tokens assigned, including 2 proposed nulls. Six M assignments excluded give 119/125 = 0.952.
outcome.notes: Complete proposed reading, 95.2% excluding M. Key reconstructed only for used signs; no independent confirmation. Name segmentation and shorter passage syntax remain uncertain.
